Definition: a watcher, i.e. an angel (as guardian)
BiblicalUsage: A watcher is an angel who keeps guard, and Daniel's dream is full of them. In Daniel 4:13 a watcher and an holy one comes down from heaven, in Daniel 4:17 the sentence is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones, and in Daniel 4:23 the watcher commands to cut the tree down but leave the stump.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the watchers are the proof that heaven is awake: the decree against the proud king is not made on earth. It is made by the holy ones who watch.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
